items.quote: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying
items.claim: The Lord spoke to Moses to deliver instructions about harvest practices

items.quote: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them
items.claim: An addressee (Moses) was commanded to speak to and instruct the children of Israel

items.quote: and shall reap the harvest thereof
items.claim: The children of Israel shall reap the harvest

items.quote: then ye shall bring a sheaf of the firstfruits of your harvest unto the priest
items.claim: The children of Israel were commanded to bring the first sheaf of the harvest to the priest
items.object: a sheaf of the firstfruits of your harvest

items.quote: And he shall wave the sheaf before the LORD, to be accepted for you
items.claim: The priest shall wave the sheaf before the Lord for acceptance of the offering

items.quote: on the morrow after the sabbath the priest shall wave it
items.claim: The priest shall wave the sheaf on the day following the sabbath

items.quote: the land which I give unto you
items.claim: God gives the land to the children of Israel
